svg.title: The board opens a waiting lane
svg.desc: Leave a clearly empty result slot beside a waiting clock. The test stays outside the frame, so expectation cannot become a depicted outcome.

**Action:** Many later decisions now depend on one run reporting back.

**Caption:**
> ONE PROCESS TAKES THE RISK. THE BOARD EXPECTS TO INHERIT THE ANSWER.
